entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martti Erik (Erkki) Ala-Könni was a Finnish university professor, ethnomusicologist, researcher, and recorder of Finnish folklore. He received a doctorate degree in folk music in 1956 from the University of Helsinki with a dissertation Die Polska-Tänze in Finnland and directed the Department of Folk Tradition of the University of Tampere in 1965–1976.

entities.name: Martti Erik Ala-Könni
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martti Erik (Erkki) Ala-Könni was a Finnish university professor, ethnomusicologist, researcher, and recorder of Finnish folklore. He received a doctorate degree in folk music in 1956 from the University of Helsinki with a dissertation Die Polska-Tänze in Finnland and directed the Department of Folk Tradition of the University of Tampere in 1965–1976.
